Q: Python Docx - Sections - Page Orientation A: 
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT

# Создаем документ
doc = Document()

# Меняем ориентацию на альбомную
section = doc.sections[-1]
new_width, new_height = section.page_height, section.page_width
section.orientation = WD_ORIENT.LANDSCAPE
section.page_width = new_width
section.page_height = new_height

# Заголовок организации
p = doc.add_paragraph()
p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
run = p.add_run("ООО «Центр Красоты и Эстетики»")
run.bold = True
run.font.size = Pt(14)

# Название документа
p2 = doc.add_paragraph()
p2.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
run2 = p2.add_run("\nШТАТНОЕ РАСПИСАНИЕ")
run2.bold = True
run2.font.size = Pt(16)

p3 = doc.add_paragraph()
p3.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
p3.add_run("Номер документа: 1\nДата составления: 07.03.2024\nНа период: 1 год с 01.04.2024")

# Создаем таблицу (10 колонок)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=10)
table.style = 'Table Grid'

# Заголовки таблицы
hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
headers = [
    "Структурное подразделение", "Должность", "Кол-во единиц", 
    "Тарифная ставка (оклад), руб.", "Надбавка 1 (стаж), руб.", "Надбавка 2 (премия), руб.", 
    "Всего в месяц, руб.", "Примечание"
]
# Объединим некоторые ячейки для соответствия логике (упрощенно)
hdr_cells[0].text = "Подразделение"
hdr_cells[1].text = "Должность"
hdr_cells[2].text = "Штат. ед."
hdr_cells[3].text = "Оклад"
hdr_cells[4].text = "Надбавка (стаж)"
hdr_cells[5].text = "Надбавка (премия)"
hdr_cells[6].text = "Всего"
hdr_cells[7].text = "Примечание"

# Данные для заполнения
data = [
    ["Администрация", "Генеральный директор", "1", "120 000", "10 000", "20 000", "150 000", ""],
    ["Администрация", "Главный бухгалтер", "1", "90 000", "5 000", "10 000", "105 000", ""],
    ["Клиентский отдел", "Старший администратор", "1", "55 000", "2 000", "8 000", "65 000", ""],
    ["Клиентский отдел", "Администратор", "2", "45 000", "0", "5 000", "100 000", "Сменный график"],
    ["Мед. отдел", "Врач-косметолог", "3", "70 000", "5 000", "15 000", "270 000", "Высш. категория"],
    ["Мед. отдел", "Специалист по электроэпиляции", "2", "55 000", "3 000", "7 000", "130 000", "Сертификат"],
    ["Мед. отдел", "Медицинская сестра", "2", "40 000", "2 000", "3 000", "90 000", ""],
    ["Хоз. отдел", "Уборщик помещений", "1", "35 000", "0", "0", "35 000", ""],
]

# Заполнение данными
for dept, pos, units, sal, n1, n2, total, note in data:
    row_cells = table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = dept
    row_cells[1].text = pos
    row_cells[2].text = units
    row_cells[3].text = sal
    row_cells[4].text = n1
    row_cells[5].text = n2
    row_cells[6].text = total
    row_cells[7].text = note

# Итоговая строка
row_cells = table.add_row().cells
row_cells[1].text = "ИТОГО:"
row_cells[2].text = "13"
row_cells[6].text = "945 000"

# Подписи
doc.add_paragraph("\n\nГенеральный директор: ____________________ / Иванов И.И. /")
doc.add_paragraph("Главный бухгалтер: ____________________ / Петрова А.А. /")

# Сохранение
file_path = "Shtatnoe_Raspitanie.docx"
doc.save(file_path)
print(file_path)

Q: Can somebody explain to me what is tags and the use of tags in rtk query? A:

The documentation explains the purpose and usage of tags: https://redux-toolkit.js.org/rtk-query/usage/automated-refetching.

Can you be more specific what you need more help with understanding?

The TL;DR is that query endpoints provide tags, and mutation endpoints invalidate them. When a subscribed query endpoint's provided tag(s) is invalidated it triggers that query endpoint to refetch its data, i.e. it makes an API call to fetch the latest data.

An example:

  1. Query endpoint fetched "data" and provided tag "A" upon completion.
  2. Mutation endpoint updates "data" and invalidates tag "A".
  3. Query endpoint's tag "A" was invalidated and is triggered to refetch "data", again providing tag "A" upon completion.

Q: What does the AND instruction do? A:

before understanding what this means for MIPS machines, you have to understand what AND and ADD mean:

if you the number 11 represented in bits:

....00001011 this is 11 in a computer.

and the number 5 ....00000101 this is 5 in a computer.

Write them below each other:

00001011
00000101

For the AND operation, you go through every column and write into the result column a 1 only if there are 1s in both lines: 00000001

This means 11 AND 5 = 1

On the other hand 11 ADD 5 = 16

If you want to read more about this you should lookt at 'logical AND operator' in google or what ever search engine you like!
